name: Samuel McMaster
role: Homestake mine superintendent; 1884 candidate for delegate
bio: Samuel McMaster was superintendent at the Homestake mine, where the editor toured the stamp mills in 1884. In September 1884 he was a Black Hills candidate for delegate to Congress at the Pierre convention.
